tax.employmentIncomeHelp: Your expected annual gross salary before deductions.
tax.bonusHelp: Expected taxable bonus or commission paid this year.
tax.taxableBenefitsHelp: Benefit in kind, such as employer-paid health insurance or a company car. This estimate treats it as taxable income but not cash pay.
tax.otherIncomeHelp: For example dividends or side income, treated here as ordinary income. Capital gains and share-option tax need a separate calculation.
tax.rentalIncomeHelp: Enter estimated taxable rental profit, not gross rent.
tax.filingStatusHelp: Joint assessment can share part of the standard rate band and credits between spouses or civil partners.
tax.marriedJoint: Married or civil partners — joint assessment
tax.marriedSeparate: Married or civil partners — separate assessment
tax.partnerIncomeHelp: Annual gross employment income for your spouse or civil partner. It is included only for joint assessment.
tax.partnerAge: Partner age at the end of 2026
tax.partnerAgeHelp: The partner’s age sets their separate pension contribution limit eligible for income-tax relief.
tax.partnerPensionHelp: The partner’s monthly pension and AVC payment. The calculator annualises it and caps relief using their age, their employment income and the €115,000 earnings limit.
tax.ageHelp: Age sets the pension contribution limit eligible for income-tax relief in this estimator.
tax.numberOfChildrenHelp: Shown to make family context explicit. A child does not automatically create an income-tax credit; qualifying carer and other credits depend on circumstances not collected here.
tax.pensionHelp: Your monthly pension and AVC payment. The calculator annualises it, then caps income-tax relief using Revenue's age-related percentage and the €115,000 earnings limit.
tax.selfEmployed: Self-employed / not claiming the Employee Tax Credit
tax.selfEmployedHelp: This switches off the Employee Tax Credit. PRSI is shown using a simplified headline rate; self-assessment and preliminary tax are not modelled.
tax.taxableIncomeFormula: Taxable income = employment income + bonus + BIK + other and rental income + partner income, less eligible pension / AVC contributions.
tax.jointBand: Joint assessment: €53,000 at 20%, plus the lower earner’s income up to €35,000 (maximum €88,000); balance at 40%.
tax.taxCreditsMath: Credits used: €2,000 personal (€4,000 joint) and €2,000 per PAYE employee.
tax.uscModelNote: The estimator applies USC separately to each partner’s income and does not model medical-card or age-based reduced rates.
tax.prsiModelNote: The model uses a 4.2375% annual blend: 4.20% to 30 September 2026 and 4.35% from 1 October.
tax.prsiScope: It is a standard-rate approximation and does not model weekly thresholds, subclasses or exemptions.
tax.pensionMathFormula: Eligible relief = the lower of annual contributions and age percentage × the lower of relevant earnings and €115,000. Relief reduces Income Tax only, not USC or PRSI.
tax.cgtFormula: CGT = 33% × net share gains above the €1,270 annual personal exemption.
tax.cgtScope: Share options can be subject to different employment-tax rules, including RTSO; this calculator does not include share tax.
tax.dailyRateHelp: Contract fee charged for each billable working day.
tax.billableDaysHelp: Days you expect to invoice after annual leave, public holidays, sick leave, bench time and other non-billable gaps.
tax.umbrellaFeeHelp: Umbrella administration fee before payroll tax.
tax.accountancyHelp: Typical company bookkeeping, annual accounts and tax-return cost.
tax.insuranceHelp: Professional indemnity, public liability and similar cover.
tax.healthHelp: Private health or benefit cost paid from contractor income.
tax.contractPensionHelp: Pension savings paid from contractor income; it is included as a cash cost in this comparison.
tax.stockGainsHelp: Annual net gains from selling shares after allowable costs and losses. This uses CGT, not PAYE; RSUs and share options are employment income and are not modelled here.
tax.contractRevenueFormula: Contract amount = daily rate × billable days. Billable days should already exclude annual leave, public holidays, sick days and bench time.
tax.umbrellaFormula: Payroll budget = contract amount − 12 × umbrella fee − health cover − contractor pension. Gross umbrella salary = payroll budget ÷ 1.1125.
tax.payrollFormula: Employer PRSI = gross salary × 11.25%. The PAYE formulas above then calculate Income Tax, USC and employee PRSI on gross salary.
tax.limitedFormula: Payroll budget = contract amount − accountancy − insurance − health cover − contractor pension. Director salary = payroll budget ÷ 1.1125, then PAYE is applied.
tax.limitedCtFormula: This model withdraws the available amount as salary, leaving no trading profit for Corporation Tax. Retained trading profit is generally taxed at 12.5% before personal extraction.

privacy.intro: See what data JobPulse stores, how it is used and protected, and how to export or delete it.
privacy.dataBody: JobPulse stores your account email, profile details you provide, preferences, application statuses, matching results, invitations you issue, and documents you upload. Vacancies are a shared catalog; candidate information belongs to each account.
privacy.processingBody: Supabase provides account authentication, database and private file storage. Profile matching runs locally in your browser and submits a numeric profile vector to the private database. Matching results are automated suggestions, not hiring decisions. You can adjust your criteria.
privacy.reportingBody: Operational error reporting, when enabled by the site operator, sends generic error types and bundled code locations to Sentry. The application strips user identifiers, messages, URLs, requests, headers, breadcrumbs and arbitrary context. Session replay and performance tracing are disabled.
privacy.accessBody: Export your profile, statuses, evaluations, issued invitations and document metadata as JSON. Download document files separately from Profile. You can edit your information and delete documents there. Account deletion removes your live account data and private files.
privacy.retentionBody: Authentication uses browser storage to maintain your session. Language and layout preferences use local storage. No advertising or third-party tracking cookies are required by the application. Private file links expire; avoid sharing exports or signed download links.
privacy.deletionBody: Deletion does not immediately erase existing provider logs or previously created backups. Completed local backups and operational logs have a maximum retention of one year; providers may retain logs for shorter periods. Local layout preferences remain in your browser until you clear site storage.
privacy.contactBody: Contact us for access, correction, erasure or questions about processing and provider retention. Optional personal information is used only for the profile and matching features you choose to use. Do not upload documents you are not entitled to share.
